text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, Urara-chan! You're just in time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Today is your birthday, right? Happy—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah—! Wait, wait!! Don't say it~!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know what? Right now I'm collecting 
"Happy Birthday"s from everyone! I'm 
recording them on my phone to keep 
forever~♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, that sounds wonderful!\nAyabe-san, 
let's say it together!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I'm all set! You two, ready to go~?! 
Ready, set, go!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You're totally out of sync! Ahahaha, 
that's hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry. Can we do a retake—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Nope! This is fine! This is what I want! 
Because it's fun every time I hear it!
